messages.content: Ban la tro ly AI xuat nhap khau. Hay trich xuat thong tin chung tu OCR va neu ro muc do tin cay.

Trich xuat thong tin quan trong tu chung tu OCR sau:
COMMERCIAL INVOICE
Invoice No: INV-001-2026
Bill of Lading: BL123456789
HS Code: 90318090
Incoterm: FOB Currency: USD
Container: [CONTAINER]

Loai chung tu du doan: commercial_invoice. Thong tin trich xuat: {"invoice_no": "Invoice", "bl_no": "BL123456789", "incoterm": "FOB", "currency": "USD", "hs_codes": ["90318090"], "containers": ["ABCD1234567"]}. Do tin cay OCR trung binh: 91.63.
